quirks.summary: Portal URL and vendor come from PlanIt's directory; neither the vendor nor any retrieval step has been verified against this portal.
quirks.detail: PlanIt reports scraper_type 'Atrium'. That label is a hint, not a finding - it is recorded elsewhere in this skill as stale at one authority and wrong at another. Fingerprint the portal before choosing a recipe, and set portal.vendor_verified when you have.
quirks.workaround: Run the vendor detection signatures in vendors.json against the portal before applying any recipe.

quirks.detail: Search and detail worked; the sampled application had no downloadable documents, or they are linked by a pattern Recipe A does not match. One application sampled, so a signal rather than a verdict. Several of these are minerals-and-waste county authorities, where a July application may genuinely carry nothing.
quirks.workaround: Sample a second application before concluding.

verification.note: Landing-page survey 2026-09-16: HTTP 200; redirected to https://planning.derbyshire.gov.uk/Disclaimer?returnUrl=%2FSearch%2FAdvanced%2F/; vendor confirmed by fingerprint (def-atrium)
Recipe A: search and detail OK over 1-31 July 2026; no document links.
